object_description: calm orthogonal large volume with a comb structure
design_condition: The volume spans the full plot depth between two streets, framing an entrance square to the north and a sports-oriented green square to the south while creating new open spaces.

positive.statement: The clear urban development of the large volume is convincing.
The public passage forms a well-functioning, spatially high-quality backbone.
The required uses are connected with a remarkably good internal organization.
The proposed building structure promises a high degree of flexibility of use.
The calm and balanced architectural expression corresponds to the flexible internal use.

negative.statement: The overall design of the outdoor spaces remains rudimentary, and the required quality of stay has not yet been sufficiently proven.
The usable space significantly exceeds the program, which has a negative impact on the economy.
The vertical access is purely functional.
The deep window reveals prevent direct visual contact across the courtyards to the street space.
The architectural potential to represent the institution as a flagship has not yet been fully exploited.
